q14.

`ShortcutService` has five RPCs, all implemented in the single backend file `server/router/api/v1/shortcut_service.go`.

The RPCs, as declared in `proto/api/v1/shortcut_service.proto` (lines 14–52):

- `ListShortcuts` (`ListShortcutsRequest` → `ListShortcutsResponse`, `GET /api/v1/{parent=users/*}/shortcuts`)
- `GetShortcut` (`GetShortcutRequest` → `Shortcut`, `GET /api/v1/{name=users/*/shortcuts/*}`)
- `CreateShortcut` (`CreateShortcutRequest` → `Shortcut`, `POST /api/v1/{parent=users/*}/shortcuts`)
- `UpdateShortcut` (`UpdateShortcutRequest` → `Shortcut`, `PATCH /api/v1/{shortcut.name=users/*/shortcuts/*}`)
- `DeleteShortcut` (`DeleteShortcutRequest` → `google.protobuf.Empty`, `DELETE /api/v1/{name=users/*/shortcuts/*}`)

Implementing file: `server/router/api/v1/shortcut_service.go`, where each RPC is a method on `*APIV1Service` — `ListShortcuts` (line 49), `GetShortcut` (95), `CreateShortcut` (135), `UpdateShortcut` (211), `DeleteShortcut` (284). The same file also holds helpers used by those methods: `extractUserAndShortcutIDFromName`, `constructShortcutName`, and `validateFilter`.

Generated (non-hand-written) code for the service lives in `proto/gen/api/v1/shortcut_service.pb.go`, `shortcut_service_grpc.pb.go`, `shortcut_service.pb.gw.go`, and `proto/gen/api/v1/apiv1connect/shortcut_service.connect.go`; tests are in `server/router/api/v1/test/shortcut_service_test.go`.
